sections.heading: Planning your Brickland Weave interior
sections.text:
Tengah’s Brickland belt sits in a new town that is still being built out. Owners who are close to keys usually need the first fit-out to work from week one: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, rather than a temporary arrangement of loose furniture while the town is still taking shape. Maison specifies that work as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we can present it in a wide room view or in closer studies of a kitchen run or a wardrobe. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed, and we will not invent a typical Brickland Weave layout.

Plantation Edge I & II and Plantation Dew are the other Tengah pages in this batch. Dew is a November 2026 BTO launch and is at a different stage; do not use its launch date as a key date for Brickland Weave. Plantation Creek, Garden Waterfront I & II and Plantation Verge were packed earlier and are also unconfirmed for keys. We will not invent walking times to any present or future MRT station.

After keys, inspect defects and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
